description:
Detects unauthorized access to API documentation endpoints like /swagger, /api-docs, /openapi.json

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg01_014", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%api%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%documentation%') AND "value" > 0
